policy: Full snapshots with no explicit reuse permission are not redistributed. These source observations are recorded by URL, retrieval date, exact fetched-byte SHA-256, size, facts used, and restore/verify steps. The hashes identify fetched snapshots; they do not imply the present live page still returns identical bytes.

sources.reuse_license: No explicit reuse license was stated in the captured source; full copy omitted from repository.
sources.fact_used: Official province district roster; facts used to establish 12 districts and the inclusion of Bozcaada and Gökçeada.
restoration_instructions: Fetch the exact URL with curl -L --fail --silent --show-error "https://www.canakkale.gov.tr/sehitler-diyari-canakkale" -o /tmp/canakkale-governor-district-list.html.restored

Run shasum -a 256 /tmp/canakkale-governor-district-list.html.restored and compare to observed_sha256. If live source changed, preserve the new retrieval date/hash separately; do not replace the 2026-10-05 observed hash.
